features.name: Escalation Decision Integration
acceptance_criteria: Use existing safety boundaries to trigger escalation.
Do not unnecessarily escalate resolvable requests.

features.name: Handoff Summary Generation
acceptance_criteria: Summary is grounded in conversation and evidence.

features.name: EscalationTicket Model
acceptance_criteria: Reason, summary and evidence are preserved.

features.name: Notification Service
acceptance_criteria: Failure is not reported as success.

features.name: Customer Escalation Response
acceptance_criteria: Customer receives an accurate escalation response.

features.name: Duplicate Escalation Protection
acceptance_criteria: Repeated processing does not create uncontrolled duplicate tickets.

features.name: Evidence Preservation
acceptance_criteria: Relevant sources and known facts are preserved.

features.name: Phase 1-4 Regression Coverage
acceptance_criteria: Knowledge, order and eligibility behaviour remains intact.
